description: Purpose: retrieve source geometry and prepare a portable site-context file. When to use: when the user wants OpenStreetMap buildings, roads, water, green space and land use worldwide or available UK flood/heritage geometry around a location for QGIS, Rhino or CAD. Returns: actual GeoJSON, SVG or 2D DXF file contents, or a ZIP containing all three from one retrieval, source preview, per-layer coverage, and a companion manifest with CRS, local origin, attribution and limitations. DXF is local WGS84 UTM metres, not longitude/latitude; polygon holes are separate closed polylines. Limitations: community OSM geometry is not a survey; no inferred heights, terrain, DWG, 3D or desktop execution; basemap geometry is generalized and clipped to the request area; other sources retain touching features by default; an optional supplied outline can clip geometry with explicit omissions and an original-source audit companion. England flood checks the address point, not all nearby polygons. Missing layers remain explicit and can produce a partial export. Parameter guidance: supply address including city/country, prior site_ref, or user-supplied coordinates {lat,lng} with country_code. Coordinate mode does not verify the address or planning jurisdiction and only retrieves regional context. Pass a two-letter country code for non-UK address lookup and every supplied point (for example in, us, fr, au), selected layers, format and optional 250–1000m radius/title. Do not treat missing geometry as a clear planning result. Chaining: every response returns site_ref; pass it unchanged into another Atlasly tool to reuse the canonical site, coordinates, boundary confidence, LPA, evidence links, and project context.

address.description: Site address or postcode, with town and country outside the UK. Alternatively pass site_ref from an earlier result; do not send both for different locations.

boundary.description: User-supplied simple WGS84 outline inside the search radius. Selects whole touching features by default; boundary_mode clip intersects geometry. Does not verify ownership. No holes or self-intersections.

boundary_mode.description: Defaults to retaining whole touching features. clip intersects geometry with the supplied outline; requires boundary. Planar WGS84, not a legal boundary/survey or completeness check.

coordinates.description: User-supplied WGS84 point. Provide an explicit country_code; omit site_ref. No address lookup or jurisdiction verification is performed.

country_code.description: ISO two-letter country code. Required for non-UK addresses and all supplied coordinates; defaults to gb only for legacy address calls. Preserve the returned site_ref country.

diagram_style.description: SVG display preset only; exported CAD/GIS geometry is unchanged. Figure-ground preserves courtyard holes; street diagram shows sampled road geometry, not routing.

radius_meters.description: Search radius in metres around the site. Requests above the caller's limit (1,000 m without an account, 2,000 m with one) are reduced or rejected.

site_ref.description: Canonical site_ref returned by any previous Atlasly tool. Pass it unchanged to chain the same resolved site into this call; address, search_area, or project_id will be filled from it when omitted.
